description: List pages in a Confluence space. Returns an array of pages with id, title, version, and link.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return (default 25).

space_key.description: The key of the Confluence space (e.g. 'ENG').

name: atlassian-mcp__confluence_list_pages
